title: How to organise the snack and lunch zone | Pantry
description:
Holds what goes into a lunchbox, and what a child is allowed to take without asking.

This is the Snack and Lunch Zone in the Pantry. About 30-45 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
One open bin at child height holding only snacks you have already said yes to, and a higher shelf holding the ones that need an adult. Every reusable container has its own lid sitting on it, and the number of containers matches the number of lunches you genuinely pack.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Match every lid to a container and bin the orphans in both directions, the lidless tubs and the lids for tubs
Straighten: Pre-approved snacks go into an open bin the child can reach without a stool.
Shine: Empty the bin and wipe it out, because crushed crackers and dried fruit-pouch drips collect in the bottom corn
Safety: Poison, choke, or strangle: whole nuts, hard sweets and grapes go straight from an open bin into a small mouth.
Standardize: The bin is the rule made visible.
Sustain: When the lunchboxes come out in the evening, lids go back onto their containers and the bin gets topped up for

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
The open bin at child height holds only pre-approved snacks and is refilled to one marked level, and no container returns to the shelf without its lid on it.

Full written steps for this zone, free:
https://6s-success.com/zones/pantry-the-snack-and-lunch-zone.html

6S Success turns Lean's six-S method into something you can actually do in a house: Sort, Straighten, Shine, Safety, Standardize, Sustain. One small zone at a time, finished in one session, and it stays finished.
